senses.gloss: the distinctive feature of the face, nose, nostril.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:3">Yeb. XVI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Yevamot 120a">120ᵃ</cite>) identification of a corpse can be established only <he>בפרצוף פנים עם הח׳</he> on seeing the face with the nose on.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:3:2">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="E00521"><he>הַכָּרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>, beg. <he>והירח זה הח׳</he> ‘the moon’ (<cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:2">Koh. XII, 2</cite>) is a metaphorical expression for the nose; <cite ref="Shabbat 151b:4">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
Taan. 29ᵃ בעל הח׳ a disguise for the well-known man, v. בָּקַשׁ. [Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ bot. חוטמה, v. חוּט III.]—2) the oblate part of a spheric body.
<cite ref="Niddah 47a">Nidd. 47ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:4">Tosef. ib. VI, 4</cite> <he>ראש הח׳</he> the top (central circle) of the oblate part of a female breast.
<cite ref="Sukkah 35b:13">Succ. 35ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חוֹטְמוֹ</he> the oblate top of the Ethrog; Y. ib. III, 53ᵈ; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוֹטְמִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:10">Tosef. Nidd. IV, 10</cite> <he>שני חוֹטְמָיו</he> the indications of the two nostrils of the embryo; <cite ref="Niddah 25a:59">Nidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>חוטמין</he> (read <he>חוטמין</he>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>נקובי חוטמו</he>).
<cite ref="Bekhorot 39a:9">Bekh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>ניקבו ח׳ וכ׳</he> if the partitions of the nostrils are perforated into one another.—Trnsf.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:2">Midd. III, 2</cite> (Mish. some ed. <cite ref="H00293"><he>חוטין</he></cite>, incorr.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:9">Succ. IV, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 48b:1">48ᵇ</cite>) <he>ומנוקבין כמין שני ח׳</he> the two bowls had cavities (outlets) like two slender snouts, v. <cite ref="D01014"><he>דָּקַק</he></cite> (v. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:12">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14 (cmp. <cite ref="H01665"><he>חַרְטוּמָא</he></cite>).
